domain_label: Sweater Brand Naming & Legal — Right-of-Publicity, Lanham, Trademark Clearance & the Hype-Adjacent Safe Path
purpose: A method for deciding what an AI-designed D2C knitwear brand (Ludhiana yarn to a 3-article California line: A1 cotton-blend core, A2 fine-acrylic value, A3 merino/lambswool premium) may legally name itself, its drops, and its SKUs, and how to clear a mark it can actually own. The method states the blunt hard-no on naming the house brand or any drop/SKU after a real athlete, celebrity, nickname, team, league, event, or meme; explains why four bodies of law (California Civil Code 3344 with prevailing-party attorneys' fees, 3344.1's 70-year post-mortem right, Lanham 43(a) false endorsement needing no registration to sue, and Class-25 apparel trademark) stack so any one is enough to lose; closes the NIL and post-mortem loopholes; anchors the exposure to the reported ~$2M Giannis 'Greek Freak' settlement; lays out the original coined, hype-ADJACENT safe path with illustrative naming DIRECTIONS but no final name; runs the 8-step clearance gate (USPTO knockout, coordinated classes 25+35, likelihood-of-confusion on sound/look/meaning, common-law and handle/state sweep, .com+IG+TikTok, mandatory Spanish reading, pro full search, file 1(b) intent-to-use early); recomputes a naming legal-risk score from identity-appropriation x transience x class-collision; and tags every money/market/legal/duty/CAC claim FACT, ESTIMATE, or UNKNOWN under the binding honesty discipline.
assumptions: the venture is a US-launch (California/Turlock) D2C knitwear brand seeded local and scaled on social, per the brand_market deep-dive; the house brand must be evergreen and ownable, transient hype quarantined to cleared drop names

the owner most wants the naming question answered and is tempted by athlete/celebrity/event/meme energy; the binding output is a hard-no on real-identity naming plus a clearable safe path, not a final name

legal exposure is stated as cited statute/case FACTs (3344, 3344.1, Lanham 43(a), USPTO fees, the reported Giannis settlement) or labeled ESTIMATEs (whether a given party would sue, attorney fee bands); a final candidate name is deliberately UNKNOWN here

US sweater import duty is fibre-set and volatile (cotton 6110.20.20 ~16.5%, wool 6110.11 ~16%, acrylic/MMF 6110.30.30 ~32%; de-minimis repealed Aug 29 2025; India surcharge moving) and travels only as a SNAPSHOT re-confirmed per PO; it bears on naming only where a name hard-codes a fibre/season the duty-and-climate reality demotes
the Central Valley is ~46% Hispanic, so a Spanish-language reading of any name and tagline is a mandatory clearance step, not optional polish
the single highest-leverage de-risking move on a finalist is a professional IP-attorney full search before any printing or a 1(b) filing
exclusions: the full brand identity system (palette, type, photography, drop-naming convention beyond the legal carve-out) which belongs to the design/T8 layer
consumer, channel, price-ladder and positioning judgement which is the consumer_positioning KB
landed-cost, CAC, contribution and the go/no-go viability P&L which is the unit-economics KB
international/Madrid-Protocol filing strategy beyond noting it is likely unnecessary for a US-only launch
drafting the actual trademark application text or rendering a binding legal opinion (an IP attorney's role); this KB defines the lane, the laws, and the clearance process

glossary.definition: The binding rule that the house brand, any drop, and any SKU must never be named after a real athlete, celebrity, nickname, team, league, event, or anyone's likeness/identity without a paid license; four laws stack so any one is enough to lose, and the asymmetric downside (their attorneys' fees) justifies extreme conservatism.

California Civil Code 3344 (right of publicity with prevailing-party attorneys' fees), 3344.1 (70-year post-mortem descendible right), Lanham Act 43(a) (false endorsement, no registration needed to sue), and Class-25 apparel trademark; you must dodge all four, not satisfy one, and any single claim firing can exceed the line's whole margin.

The decisive feature of Civil Code 3344: a losing infringer pays the prevailing party's attorneys' fees, so a celebrity's legal bill is borne by the brand if it loses, a cost that can exceed the entire line's contribution margin and make even a winnable fight uneconomic to risk.

Name/image/likeness licensing lets even a local college athlete license and enforce their name, so 'it is just a local kid, not a star' is not a margin of safety; whether a given local athlete would actually sue a micro-brand is an ESTIMATE, but that it is not a safe harbor holds regardless.

An original coined, arbitrary, or suggestive wordmark plus palette and drop-naming convention that captures California/youth/sport-adjacent energy in its rhythm without referencing any real person, team, league, event, or meme, so it is registrable and ownable rather than licensable or suable.

The single preserved nuance: a cleared, non-identity, non-protected cultural or meme reference may live in a LIMITED DROP name after clearance, never as the house brand; this is a disagreement about where (drop vs house), not about whether a real athlete's identity is usable, which it is not without a license.

Apparel is USPTO Class 25 and online retail is Class 35; the office treats them as coordinated for likelihood-of-confusion, so a knitwear D2C mark must be cleared in BOTH, not just one, before it is considered ownable.

The confusion test that compares marks on how they sound, how they look, and what they mean, not just on exact spelling, so a differently spelled but identically sounding or meaning mark can still be blocked or sued.

A USPTO application filed under Section 1(b) before any sale, reserving priority in line for a mark the applicant has a bona fide intent to use; filed early it locks the brand's place before the launch drop ships, ahead of selling a single unit.

A recomputing labeled-ESTIMATE product, risk = identity_appropriation x transience x class_collision, where each input is a 0-1 ESTIMATE; multiplicative so any single high factor (an athlete's identity, a decaying meme, a colliding Class-25 mark) drives the score high, distinguishing an ownable house mark from a name that must be killed or quarantined to a drop.

nodes.definition: Lay out California Civil Code 3344, the right of publicity: knowing commercial use of a person's name, voice, signature, photograph, or likeness on or in products triggers the GREATER of $750 or the person's actual damages, PLUS the infringer's profits attributable to the use, PLUS punitive damages, PLUS -- decisively -- the PREVAILING PARTY's attorneys' fees and costs [FACT -- statute]. The fee-shifting is the killer: if the brand loses, a celebrity's lawyers are paid by the brand, and that bill can exceed the entire line's contribution margin, so the asymmetry alone justifies extreme conservatism regardless of how likely a suit is.

nodes.definition: Close the 'they are dead' loophole with California Civil Code 3344.1: the right of publicity is DESCENDIBLE for 70 YEARS AFTER DEATH and is owned and enforced by the estate or its assignees [FACT -- statute]. This means historical or nostalgic naming after a dead public figure carries the same right-of-publicity exposure as a living one for seven decades, on top of any trademark the estate may hold.

It is necessary but NOT sufficient -- a clean knockout does not clear common-law users, sound/meaning-similar marks, or social handles, all of which later steps cover. The knockout is run on every finalist and every drop name as the first computational filter.

nodes.definition: Step 2: search and clear COORDINATED CLASSES 25 + 35. Apparel is Class 25; online retail / store services is Class 35; the USPTO treats them as COORDINATED for likelihood-of-confusion, so a name clear in Class 25 but colliding in Class 35 (or vice versa) is NOT clear [FACT -- USPTO coordinated-class practice]. A D2C knitwear brand both makes apparel (25) and sells it online (35), so it must clear and ideally register in BOTH. Clearing only one class is a common and expensive miss -- a Class-35 retail conflict can block or sue a perfectly clean Class-25 apparel mark.

nodes.definition: Step 3: run a LIKELIHOOD-OF-CONFUSION analysis on SOUND, LOOK, and MEANING -- not just exact spelling [FACT -- confusion doctrine]. Two marks confuse consumers when they sound alike (phonetic equivalence), look alike (visual/typographic similarity), or mean the same (connotation/translation, including a foreign-language equivalent), even with different letters. A coined name that is spelled uniquely but pronounced identically to a registered apparel mark, or that translates to the same idea, can still be refused or sued. This step is where a 'we changed one letter' rationalization dies; the analysis is conceptual, not orthographic.

nodes.definition: Make the naming legal-risk judgement computationally explicit and recomputing: naming_risk = identity_appropriation x transience x class_collision, where each input is a 0-1 ESTIMATE -- identity_appropriation = how much the name uses or implies a real person/team/league/event identity (0 = pure coined, 1 = a living athlete's name); transience = how welded the name is to a perishable hype reference (0 = evergreen coined, 1 = a single 2026 meme); class_collision = likelihood-of-confusion pressure in coordinated Class 25/35 (0 = clear knockout, 1 = an existing apparel mark). It is MULTIPLICATIVE on purpose: any single factor near 1 drives the whole score high, so an athlete name (appropriation~1), a dying meme (transience~1), or a colliding mark (collision~1) each independently condemns a name. Worked example -- a coined Californian wordmark, knockout-clean, no hype welding: 0.1 x 0.15 x 0.2 = 0.003 (own it); an athlete nickname on apparel: 0.95 x 0.6 x 0.8 = 0.456 and, because appropriation~1, it is a kill regardless. The score is a labeled-ESTIMATE comparator that ranks and gates candidates, never a probability of suit.

included: the multiplicative identity_appropriation x transience x class_collision score
the any-factor-near-1-condemns property and the comparator-not-probability framing
excluded: the final composed verdict (its own node)
the per-law mechanics that set each input (law nodes)

cons.claim: The three inputs are labeled ESTIMATEs, so the score's precision is illusory and weights/factor reads are judgements
cons.example: scoring identity_appropriation at 0.95 vs 0.7 for an 'adjacent' name shifts the rank without new fact

failure_modes: reading the score as a probability of being sued rather than a comparator

treating ESTIMATE inputs as measured
acceptance_tests: the node states naming_risk = identity_appropriation x transience x class_collision with 0-1 ESTIMATE inputs, recomputes both worked examples (0.003 and 0.456), and notes any factor near 1 condemns the name as a comparator not a suit-probability

edges.resolution_rule: keep the hype in the wordmark's rhythm and palette only; if a direction's candidate implies a real identity it fails the appropriation ban and is reframed coined, never licensed

edges.why_related: the verdict consumes the confusion read as a core clearance input
the verdict applies common-law and handle findings as potential KILL conditions
no ownable handles is a verdict KILL condition the availability node supplies
a failed Spanish read is a verdict KILL condition
the cost/timeline informs the GO path's filing-feasibility within the verdict
the 70-year post-mortem right makes a deceased-figure name a verdict KILL
the review loop watches the verdict's inputs and re-triggers it when they change
a newly surfaced opposing mark sends the candidate back through the knockout and class search
a pinned 2026 youth hype signal or a decayed reference re-opens the naming lanes for new candidates

conflict_axes.name: hype_energy_vs_ownable_mark
conflict_axes.description: The owner wants borrowed athlete/celebrity/hype recognition while the brand needs an original mark it can register and defend; the two pull opposite ways.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: put the energy in the wordmark's rhythm and palette and quarantine transient hype to cleared drop names; never borrow a real identity for the house brand

conflict_axes.name: drop_carveout_vs_identity_ban
conflict_axes.description: A cleared non-identity reference may live in a drop name, but the same impulse tempts a real-identity use under cover of 'it is only a drop'.
poles: allow the cleared reference in a drop
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: permit only a cleared, non-identity reference in a drop; any real person/team/league/event identity is an automatic KILL at every scope

conflict_axes.name: knockout_clean_vs_full_clearance
conflict_axes.description: A clean self-serve knockout feels like clearance but misses common-law users, sound/meaning conflicts, and handle squatting.
poles: require the full gate + attorney search
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: treat the knockout as necessary-not-sufficient; a GO requires the full 8-step gate and an attorney opinion, never a clean knockout alone

conflict_axes.name: single_class_vs_coordinated_classes
conflict_axes.description: Clearing only Class 25 (apparel) is cheaper but misses Class-35 (retail) conflicts the USPTO coordinates against it.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: a D2C brand both makes and sells apparel, so clear and register both coordinated classes despite the doubled fee

conflict_axes.name: exact_spelling_vs_sound_look_meaning
conflict_axes.description: A 'we changed one letter' rationalization relies on exact spelling, but confusion is judged on sound, look, and meaning.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: run the confusion analysis on phonetics, visual similarity, and connotation/translation, not orthography; a sound-alike or meaning-equivalent still conflicts

conflict_axes.name: legal_clearance_vs_handle_availability
conflict_axes.description: A name can be legally clear yet have no ownable .com/IG/TikTok, making it unusable for a social-first D2C brand.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: treat .com + Instagram + TikTok availability as a binding practical gate alongside legal clearance; a clean name with no handles cannot launch the channel plan

conflict_axes.name: file_early_vs_defer_cost
conflict_axes.description: Filing a 1(b) intent-to-use early locks priority but spends money before any sale; deferring saves cash but risks losing the name.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: file 1(b) early to lock priority before the launch drop; the cleared name is the asset and a faster filer can leapfrog a deferred application

conflict_axes.name: decisive_answer_vs_honesty_tagging
conflict_axes.description: The owner wants a flat 'is this name safe' while the honesty discipline returns a FACT/ESTIMATE/UNKNOWN spectrum and refuses a binding legal opinion.
poles: tag the spectrum and refer to an attorney
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: give a decisive own/drop/kill verdict but tag every legal/money claim and route a finalist to an attorney for the binding opinion the KB cannot give

conflict_axes.name: fibre_season_hardcode_vs_evergreen_name
conflict_axes.description: A vivid name welded to a fibre or season (e.g. wool/winter) reads concrete but boxes in a warm-climate line whose duty and weather demote wool to a thin capsule.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: never hard-code a fibre or season; the climate and duty reality (cotton-led, wool a thin capsule) require an evergreen name that the line can grow within

conflict_axes.name: snapshot_clearance_vs_drift
conflict_axes.description: A once-cleared name reads as settled, but new mark filings, squatted handles, decayed memes, and a moving duty snapshot drift it out of clearance.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: hold a cleared name as a dated baseline and let the review loop, not assumption, re-run the gate when an opposed mark, squatted handle, decayed reference, or moved duty snapshot fires

edge_cases.description: A name is proposed after a real athlete's nickname because 'it is just a nickname, not his legal name'
edge_cases.trigger: a nickname or alias of a real person is offered as a brand or drop name
edge_cases.mitigation: treat a nickname as identity under 3344/43(a); the Greek Freak ~$2M settlement was a nickname matter, so it is an automatic KILL

edge_cases.description: A deceased icon's name is proposed as a 'heritage' or 'tribute' brand name
edge_cases.trigger: a dead public figure is referenced on the assumption their identity is free
edge_cases.mitigation: apply the 70-year post-mortem right; the estate owns and enforces it, so an in-window figure is a KILL

edge_cases.description: A local CSU/Turlock athlete's name is used because 'they are not famous and would never sue'
edge_cases.trigger: a local college athlete's identity is treated as a safe margin
edge_cases.mitigation: NIL makes the local athlete's name licensable and enforceable; it is not a safety margin, so KILL regardless of suit-probability

edge_cases.description: A hype-adjacent name is adopted that implies an athlete endorses the line, with no registration of his name
edge_cases.trigger: a name reads to consumers as 'official gear of X' without literal name use
edge_cases.mitigation: Lanham 43(a) reaches implied endorsement with no registration needed to sue; raise identity_appropriation and KILL

edge_cases.description: A name passes a clean USPTO knockout and is treated as fully cleared
edge_cases.trigger: an identical/near-identical knockout returns clean and is read as clearance
edge_cases.mitigation: treat the knockout as necessary-not-sufficient; require the common-law sweep, confusion analysis, and attorney search before any GO

edge_cases.description: A name is cleared in Class 25 only and a Class-35 retail conflict surfaces after launch
edge_cases.trigger: clearance covers apparel but not online-retail services
edge_cases.mitigation: clear and register both coordinated classes 25 + 35 before launch; a single-class clearance is insufficient for D2C

edge_cases.description: A uniquely spelled coined name is phonetically identical to a registered apparel mark
edge_cases.trigger: a 'changed one letter' name sounds the same as an existing mark
edge_cases.mitigation: run confusion on sound/look/meaning; a phonetic match raises class_collision and can block or sue despite unique spelling

edge_cases.description: A legally clear name has its .com parked at a premium and its TikTok handle squatted
edge_cases.trigger: a cleared name has no ownable handle set
edge_cases.mitigation: treat .com+IG+TikTok availability as a binding gate; a clean name with no handles is a KILL for a social-first brand

edge_cases.description: A name clean in English is offensive or comic in Mexican Spanish and ships to the ~46% Hispanic seed market
edge_cases.trigger: an English-only read is run and the Spanish read is skipped
edge_cases.mitigation: run the mandatory Mexican-Spanish read before legal spend; a failed read is a KILL before an attorney is engaged

edge_cases.description: A cleared meme/event reference is welded onto the house brand rather than a drop
edge_cases.trigger: a transient reference is used as the evergreen house name
edge_cases.mitigation: limit a cleared non-identity reference to a drop name; keep the house brand original and evergreen

edge_cases.description: A name is hard-coded to wool/winter and the warm-climate line later leads on cotton with wool a thin capsule
edge_cases.trigger: a fibre or season is baked into the brand name
edge_cases.mitigation: keep the name fibre/season-agnostic; the climate and duty reality (cotton-led) require a name the line can grow within

edge_cases.description: A name is filed and printed before the attorney full search, and an opposition lands post-launch
edge_cases.trigger: self-serve clearance is treated as sufficient and printing proceeds
edge_cases.mitigation: require an attorney full search before filing/printing and a 1(b) early; route a surfaced opposition back through the gate via the review loop

workflow.action: Frame the naming decision and the hard-no scope
workflow.description: Set the house/drop/SKU scopes and the hard-no on real-identity naming at every scope
workflow.gate: the hard-no is stated across house brand, drop, and SKU and the three scopes are named

workflow.action: Establish the four-law stack and the dodge-all rule
workflow.description: Name 3344, 3344.1, Lanham 43(a), and Class-25 as a stack any one of which loses
workflow.gate: all four laws are named as a stack with the dodge-all-four and fee-asymmetry rationale

workflow.description: State the $750 floor + profits + punitives + prevailing-party fees and the fee-shifting asymmetry
workflow.gate: the remedy structure and fee-shifting are stated [FACT] with the post-mortem and Lanham layers cross-linked

workflow.description: Close the local-kid (NIL), deceased (3344.1), and meme/event (transience+TM) loopholes
workflow.gate: the NIL, post-mortem, and meme/event loopholes are each closed with the would-they-sue question marked an ESTIMATE

workflow.description: Define the original coined/arbitrary/suggestive ownable mark with hype quarantined to cleared drops
workflow.gate: the own-the-vibe-borrow-no-identity path and the drop-name quarantine are stated with the registrable payoff

workflow.description: List the coined-Californian, suggestive-climate-true, sport-hype-adjacent, and AI-native lanes, no finalist
workflow.gate: the four lanes are given as directions not finalists, the final name is UNKNOWN, and no fibre/season is hard-coded

workflow.description: Read each candidate name and tagline in Mexican Spanish before any legal spend
workflow.gate: a Mexican-Spanish read of name and tagline is run before clearance spend, tied to the ~46% Hispanic base

workflow.action: Run the USPTO knockout and coordinated-class search
workflow.description: Knockout identical/near-identical, then clear coordinated Class 25 + 35
workflow.gate: the knockout is run as necessary-not-sufficient and both coordinated classes 25 + 35 are cleared

workflow.description: Test sound/look/meaning, then sweep common-law users, state entities, and social handles
workflow.gate: confusion is judged on sound/look/meaning and the common-law/state/handle sweep is completed

workflow.description: Verify .com + Instagram + TikTok are all ownable for the candidate
workflow.gate: .com + Instagram + TikTok are confirmed ownable as a binding practical gate

workflow.action: Run the attorney search, file 1(b), and budget the cost
workflow.description: Commission the attorney full search, file 1(b) early, and record the gov/attorney fees and timeline
workflow.gate: an attorney full search precedes filing, a 1(b) is filed early to lock priority, and the ~$350/class + ~$1-2.5k + 12-18mo cost is recorded

workflow.action: Score, compose the verdict, and set the review loop
workflow.description: Recompute naming_risk, compose the GO/QUARANTINE-TO-DROP/KILL verdict under the honesty guardrail, and set refresh triggers
workflow.gate: the verdict composes the law stack, the gate, the Spanish read, handles, and the score into GO/QUARANTINE/KILL with real identity an automatic KILL, and a review-trigger list exists

priority_rationale: The decision frame and the four-law stack are foundational because every downstream clearance step and the final verdict read from them; the four law nodes and the loophole closures (NIL, post-mortem, meme/event transience) establish why real-identity naming is an automatic KILL before any process runs; the safe hype-adjacent path and its naming directions give the constructive answer the laws make necessary; the mandatory Spanish read and the 8-step clearance gate (knockout, coordinated 25+35, sound/look/meaning, common-law/handle, .com+IG+TikTok, attorney search, 1(b) early, cost/timeline) operationalize ownability in order; the multiplicative naming-risk score makes any single fatal factor dominate; the honesty guardrail governs every legal/money/duty claim; and the composed verdict plus the review loop come last because they fold all upstream signals into a GO/QUARANTINE-TO-DROP/KILL decision and a self-correcting refresh.

dominance_rules.rule: A real person/team/league/event identity dominates every other signal and is an automatic KILL
dominance_rules.rationale: the four-law stack means any single identity-based claim can lose, and the fee-shifting downside exceeds the line's margin
dominance_rules.trigger: a candidate uses or implies a real identity at any scope
dominance_rules.action: KILL the candidate regardless of a clean knockout, available handles, or a clean Spanish read

dominance_rules.rule: The honesty guardrail dominates any pressure for a flat legal yes/no
dominance_rules.rationale: the KB cannot give a binding legal opinion and must not fake precision on suit probability or fee bands
dominance_rules.trigger: a request for 'is this name safe' as a flat answer
dominance_rules.action: give a tagged own/drop/kill verdict and route a finalist to an attorney for the binding opinion

dominance_rules.rule: Full clearance dominates a clean knockout
dominance_rules.rationale: the knockout misses common-law users, sound/meaning conflicts, and squatted handles
dominance_rules.trigger: a clean knockout is treated as clearance
dominance_rules.action: withhold a GO until the full 8-step gate and an attorney search pass

dominance_rules.rule: Coordinated two-class clearance dominates single-class cost savings
dominance_rules.rationale: a D2C brand both makes (25) and sells (35) apparel and the USPTO coordinates the classes
dominance_rules.trigger: clearing only Class 25 to save the per-class fee
dominance_rules.action: clear and register both classes despite the doubled fee

dominance_rules.rule: Sound/look/meaning confusion dominates a unique-spelling argument
dominance_rules.rationale: confusion is conceptual and phonetic, not orthographic
dominance_rules.trigger: a name is defended on its unique spelling alone
dominance_rules.action: block or flag it if it sounds or means the same as a prior mark

dominance_rules.rule: Handle availability dominates legal clearance for a social-first brand
dominance_rules.rationale: the channel strategy cannot run without ownable .com/IG/TikTok
dominance_rules.trigger: a legally clear name has no ownable handle set
dominance_rules.action: treat it as a KILL or require a strong handle workaround before any GO

dominance_rules.rule: The mandatory Spanish read dominates an English-only clearance
dominance_rules.rationale: a name fatal in Mexican Spanish dies in the ~46% Hispanic seed market regardless of English clarity
dominance_rules.trigger: a candidate is advanced on an English read alone
dominance_rules.action: run the Spanish read first and KILL a failure before any attorney spend

dominance_rules.rule: The drop scope dominates the house scope for any transient or cultural reference
dominance_rules.rationale: the house brand must be evergreen and the carve-out is bounded to drops
dominance_rules.trigger: a meme/event/cultural reference is proposed for the house brand
dominance_rules.action: limit a cleared non-identity reference to a drop name and keep the house brand original

dominance_rules.rule: Early 1(b) filing dominates deferring the cost
dominance_rules.rationale: priority is lost to a faster filer and the cleared name is the asset
dominance_rules.trigger: filing is deferred to save cash before launch
dominance_rules.action: file the 1(b) early to lock priority before the launch drop

dominance_rules.rule: A multiplicative high factor dominates a low average in the risk score
dominance_rules.rationale: any single near-1 factor (appropriation, transience, collision) condemns a name
dominance_rules.trigger: a name has one very high factor but low others
dominance_rules.action: treat the high factor as condemning rather than averaging it down

dominance_rules.rule: A flagged low-confidence input dominates a confident downstream verdict built on it
dominance_rules.rationale: a verdict cannot be more certain than its weakest load-bearing clearance input
dominance_rules.trigger: a verdict leans on an un-searched class or an unconfirmed common-law user
dominance_rules.action: cap the verdict's confidence at that of its weakest input and name the confirmation step

dominance_rules.rule: The corrected duty SNAPSHOT dominates any stale or wrong duty figure
dominance_rules.rationale: de-minimis is repealed and the rate is volatile; the cotton ~7% figure was a corrected error
dominance_rules.trigger: a name or plan relies on cotton ~7% duty or a hardened forward rate
dominance_rules.action: use cotton ~16.5% / wool ~16% / acrylic ~32% as a SNAPSHOT re-confirmed per PO, never ~7%

anti_rework_rules.rule: Apply the real-identity KILL before any clearance spend
anti_rework_rules.prevents: paying for a knockout, attorney search, or handle reservation on a name that the appropriation ban already condemns

anti_rework_rules.rule: Run the mandatory Spanish read before the attorney full search
anti_rework_rules.prevents: spending attorney fees on a name that is fatal in Mexican Spanish and must be discarded

anti_rework_rules.rule: Clear both coordinated classes 25 + 35 the first time, not Class 25 then 35 later
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a post-launch Class-35 conflict forcing a rename after apparel-only clearance

anti_rework_rules.rule: Test sound/look/meaning at the confusion step, not just exact spelling
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a phonetic or meaning conflict surfacing after filing that a spelling-only search missed

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm .com + IG + TikTok availability before committing to a name
anti_rework_rules.prevents: adopting a legally clear name whose handles are squatted, forcing a late rename

anti_rework_rules.rule: File the 1(b) intent-to-use early, before the launch drop
anti_rework_rules.prevents: losing priority to a faster filer and re-clearing a new name after the drop

anti_rework_rules.rule: Tag every legal/money/duty claim FACT/ESTIMATE/UNKNOWN/SNAPSHOT as it is written
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a later honesty sweep that must re-caveat claims already stated as flat facts

anti_rework_rules.rule: Keep the house brand fibre/season-agnostic from the first candidate
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a wool/winter-welded name boxing in a cotton-led warm-climate line and forcing a rebrand

iteration_protocol.trigger: the owner proposes a candidate house, drop, or SKU name
iteration_protocol.action: run it through the appropriation KILL, the Spanish read, the 8-step gate, the risk score, and the verdict

iteration_protocol.trigger: an opposing registered mark or unregistered common-law user surfaces after clearance
iteration_protocol.action: re-run the knockout, coordinated-class, and confusion steps and re-issue the verdict

iteration_protocol.trigger: a target .com/Instagram/TikTok handle is squatted or freed
iteration_protocol.action: re-check handle availability and update the verdict's practical-gate status

iteration_protocol.trigger: a statute in the four-law stack or the USPTO fee/1(b)/use-deadline rules change
iteration_protocol.action: refresh the affected law/cost node and re-issue any dependent verdicts

iteration_protocol.trigger: a hype reference inside a quarantined drop name decays past its useful life
iteration_protocol.action: retire the drop name and re-open the naming lanes for a fresh cleared reference

iteration_protocol.trigger: the 2026 Central-Valley-youth hype signal (an upstream UNKNOWN owned by no file) is pinned
iteration_protocol.action: re-open the sport-hype-adjacent lane and generate cleared candidates against the real signal

iteration_protocol.trigger: the India-to-US sweater duty / de-minimis SNAPSHOT moves enough to reconsider a fibre/season-hard-coding name
iteration_protocol.action: re-check that no candidate hard-codes a fibre/season the duty-and-climate reality demotes and re-tag the duty SNAPSHOT

iteration_protocol.trigger: the risk-score weighting or a candidate's appropriation/transience/collision input is revised
iteration_protocol.action: recompute naming_risk and re-issue the verdict if the score crosses a gate threshold
